actual_Boolean_family: All truth tables in dimensions 0 through 3
parameter_domain: n=0,1,2,3; terminal remaining-coordinate cutoff 0,1,2; leaf reference mode uniform or history-dependent tilted subprobability
symmetry_reduction: None; 278 truth tables times 3 stopping rules times 2 reference modes
arithmetic: Integer direct Walsh sums, Fraction probabilities, exact rational coefficient vectors of log2 primes; no numerical logarithms

finite_to_infinite: Analytic proof supplies all finite trees; finite checks only validate algebra and implementation
